records.title: The Future of Fully Homomorphic Encryption System: From a Storage I/O Perspective
records.reason: This paper analyzes storage I/O in fully homomorphic encryption systems, not LLM serving or KV-cache management. The shared storage theme with inference systems is superficial; its threat model and computations are cryptographic.

records.title: Scaling depth capacity via zero/one-layer model expansion
records.reason: Zero/one-layer model expansion increases depth capacity through model expansion and evaluates quality/transfer behavior; the paper does not establish reduced inference compute, memory, or latency. Its OLMoE relation is not enough to show an efficiency lineage.

records.title: Optimal Attention Temperature Improves the Robustness of In-Context Learning under Distribution Shift in High Dimensions
records.reason: The work studies robustness of in-context learning under distribution shift, not inference cost or serving systems.

records.title: GFMLLM: Enhance multi-modal large language model for global and fine-grained visual spatial perception
records.reason: Publisher search record exposes an abstract and selected article text, but opening the ScienceDirect full-text page returned HTTP 403. The abstract explicitly claims token aggregation to reduce MLLM generation latency, so this is promising but needs a readable primary full text.

records.title: Cardiac magnetic resonance imaging-large language model Meta AI: a finetuned large language model for identifying findings and associated attributes in cardiac magnetic resonance imaging reports
records.reason: The work is a clinical report-analysis fine-tuning application without a model-efficiency method.
